# Nationwide enacted-law audit (starting place: Postville, Iowa)

The watched run audited 21 enacted laws. 6 effect rows have attributable records; 36 lack proof or have a recorded limit. Research identifies 0 about-zero effect rows. These counts do not establish complete coverage of every supported consequence.

## Why-chain

Enactment supplies answers. Current-law readers resolve jurisdiction, rank and dates. The audit follows saved effect records and keeps missing attribution separate from no effect. The terminal for an unproven row is an absent record or an unmeasured reader.

## Research

The JSON includes each outcome link's source, size, range, delay and status, plus exact pinned trace references. No new sizes or legal power are inferred.

## Revisions

Plain yes/no laws can activate readers. Typed provisions are not required by this audit. Repeated starting answers are labeled without suppressing observed effects.

## Numbered parts

1. Reusable seed/place/month runner.
2. One row for each registered law effect, including unsized and inert links.
3. Explicit evidence gaps for readers without attributable records.

## Simulated, records, world pieces, checks

The normal observer advances to successive calendar-month anniversaries. Canonical records supply evidence. Missing reader coverage remains a world or audit gap. Counts are observed records, not inferred outcomes.
